turnos.t: Do a firm's objectives stay the same forever?
No, they change when the situation changes. A start-up aims to survive. Once established, it chases growth and market share. Mature firms add profit, shareholder value and ethical aims.

Internal reasons, like new owners, a new stage of growth or financial problems. And external ones: a recession, new competitors, new laws or a pandemic. In a recession, a growth objective can quickly become survival.
